task_pattern: Notification retry policy for transient delivery failures
description: Maintain centralized retry policy for notification channels by retrying transient email, SMS, and webhook provider failures while stopping permanent failures.
solution_steps: Inspect failing channel-specific tests before changing retry behavior.
Keep retry decisions centralized in src/retryPolicy.js.
Treat email SMTP_TEMP as retryable and SMTP_PERM as non-retryable.
Treat SMS_429 as retryable and SMS_400 as non-retryable.
Treat WEBHOOK_503 as retryable and WEBHOOK_410 as non-retryable.
Run the focused SMS test after the SMS update, then run npm test after the webhook update.
pitfalls: Do not retry every provider error; permanent failures should stop.
Do not implement channel-specific retry logic in individual senders when src/retryPolicy.js is the shared policy.
SMS 429 is a rate-limit/transient signal, but SMS 400 is a permanent bad-request signal.
Webhook 503 is transient, but webhook 410 means the endpoint is gone and should not retry.
